tin.s: I’m a hairstylist of almost 15 years and I have found this last year to be the hardest to build clientele. My pricing is not high either. I know the economy is changing but I’ve never struggled this bad. Am I the only one feeling like this? I’m even having to look for a part time job to make up for what I’ve lost. I’m in the Glendale area so if anyone is looking for someone I’m here! submitted by /u/mosi_bunny_89…
